text.Você pede em linguagem natural e o Agent: You ask in plain language and Agentio gets it done: it researches, writes, summarizes, compares, and organizes routines and reminders. A few everyday examples:
text.Posso, por exemplo: vigiar o preço da pa: I can, for example: watch airfare and tell you the moment it drops; compare 10 plans and tell you which one pays off; make sure you never miss a due date again.
text.Consigo, por exemplo: criar lembretes de: I can, for example: set reminders for everything (car service, property tax, gifts) and send you a full summary of your day at 7am: emails, calendar, weather and news.
text.Consigo, por exemplo: transformar 5 PDFs: I can, for example: turn 5 huge PDFs into a 2-page summary with flashcards, or explain any subject until you say “now I get it”.
text.Consigo, por exemplo: criar o site compl: I can, for example: build your company's complete website in a day — logo, copy, contact form — and then monitor what people say about it on social media.
text.Consigo, por exemplo: transformar uma re: I can, for example: turn a recorded meeting into ready-to-post LinkedIn content, a thread and a newsletter — with AI-generated images on the spot.
text.Posso: preencher aquele formulário inter: I can: fill in that endless form, cancel forgotten subscriptions and sort 2,000 photos by date and place.
text.Consigo, por exemplo: comparar 15 notebo: I can, for example: compare 15 laptops or PCs and hand you a table with the best value and a link to the best deal.
text.Detecto apps suspeitos com acesso às sua: I spot suspicious apps with access to your accounts and tell you exactly what to revoke now — before it becomes a problem.
